templates.expression: Keep this exact image: same character, same pose, same size and position in the frame, same image size, same hair and hair colour, same skin tone, same tank top and shorts, same transparent background. Change only the eyes and mouth to this expression: {{look.expression}}. Do not move, zoom, crop, recolour or redraw anything else.
templates.head: Keep this exact image: same character, same pose, same size and position in the frame, same neutral face with open eyes, same hair colour, same tank top and shorts, same transparent background. Add only this: {{look.description}}, sitting naturally on top of the head, fully inside the image. The small hair strand on top of the head is hidden under it. The hat is at most slightly wider than the hair. Face and the rest of the hair unchanged. No glasses. Do not move, zoom, crop, recolour or redraw anything else.
templates.face: Keep this exact image: same character, same pose, same size and position in the frame, same neutral face with open eyes, same hair and hair colour, same tank top and shorts, same transparent background. Add only this: {{look.description}}. No hat. Do not move, zoom, crop, recolour or redraw anything else.
templates.outfit: Keep this exact image: same character, same pose, same size and position in the frame, same neutral face with open eyes, same hair and hair colour, same skin tone, same transparent background. Replace the gray tank top and shorts completely with: {{look.description}}. The tank top must be completely gone: no straps, no gray fabric visible anywhere. Simple shapes, few folds, no small patterns, no logos, nothing in the hands. No hat, no glasses. Do not move, zoom, crop, recolour or redraw anything else.
templates.aura: A decorative circular aura effect for a character portrait: {{look.description}}. Centered in a square image, the center area is completely empty and transparent, effect concentrated in a ring around the center, soft glowing painterly style allowed, transparent background outside the effect, no character, no text, no watermark.
templates.frame: A circular decorative frame ring for a player avatar: {{look.description}}. Perfectly round, the inside of the ring is completely empty and transparent, ring thickness about 8 percent of the image width, centered in a square image, clean cel-shaded style with colored outlines, transparent background inside and outside the ring, no character, no text, no watermark.
templates.bot: Keep this exact image's proportions, pose, size and position in the frame, and the transparent background, but redraw the character as a cute chibi robot: {{look.description}}. Same 2.25-heads-tall proportions with an oversized round head, same standing pose with arms slightly away from the body, no hair, no clothing, smooth rounded metal body, cel-shaded with colored outlines, semi-painterly anime rendering. Face: {{look.expression}}. Do not move, zoom or crop.
